Messages.Author: noir
Messages.Body:
I was wondering something here.
Does the card 'Loving Agony' work similar to 'Catatonic fear' in that, that it causes the damage after combat, making it non-preventable? The reason I'm wondering is because they're worded quite different with one saying "combat ends and the opposing minion takes 1 damage." whilst the other say "...as above (combat ends) and inflict 1 damage to the opposing minion once combat ends, if the range is close".

Loving Agony
Cardtype: Combat
Cost: 1 blood
Discipline: Valeren/Animalism
Only usable at close range.
[ani] Strike: hand strike at +1 damage.
[val] Strike: combat ends and the opposing minion takes 1 damage.
[VAL] As [val] above, and this vampire may burn 1 blood to untap before combat ends.

Catatonic Fear
Cardtype: Combat
Cost: 1 blood
Discipline: Presence
Strike: combat ends.
As above, and inflict 1 damage to the opposing minion once combat ends if the range is close.

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
If some strike reads: "Strike: Combat ends, and do something", then something happens after combat.
The only exception is when the strike reads "Combat ends and untap" (Majesty, Earth Meld, Loving Agony, ..), where the *this vampire untaps* part happens before the end of combat.

So, yes, the damage from Loving Agony is similar to the damage from Catatonic Fear, vis-a-vis their timing. They are inflicted after combat, and can't be prevented with combat cards.

I would disagree with Floppy.

Catatonic Fear has (at ) Strike: Combat ends, and inflict 1 damage to the opposing minion once combat ends if the range is close.

Loving Agony has (at ) Strike: combat ends and the opposing minion takes 1 damage.

Loving Agony does not have the comma "," between the Strike and the "and". So Loving Agony would work like Majesty (Strike: Combat Ends and untap this vampire) and deal the damage during combat which would make it preventable. At  the effect, while separated by a comma, explicitly states its timing.

LSJ has ruled that you can play Target Vitals on Catatonic Fear and it will deal the additional damage.
